headline: Groß National Product Powers 123 Past test4
deck: 123 beat test4 38-27, Groß's eleven the top score of the tie
body:
Groß settled it. Eleven for 123's midfielder was the highest score on either side, and Schade's eight behind him gave 123 a top pair test4 never came close to matching. Haaland's six and threes from Horníček and Stach padded the total to 38, comfortable in the end.

Cherki carried test4 as far as one man could, his seven the only return worth the name. Justin's six from defence backed him, but the drop after that was a cliff. E.Le Fée managed five, and then the floor gave way.

Gray, Mbeumo and N.Williams returned two apiece, six points from three men who were meant to do more. That is where the eleven-point margin lives. Cherki and Justin did their part; nobody else in test4's line-up got out of second gear.
